description: Connect SalesTouch to configure organization profiles, units, role permissions, employee invitations, reporting scopes, and sales processes, then govern B2B and B2C sales execution and non-sales work with evidence-backed management reviews.

display.description_en: Connect SalesTouch to configure organization profiles, units, role permissions, employee invitations, reporting scopes, and sales processes, then govern B2B and B2C sales execution and non-sales work with evidence-backed management reviews.
display.description_zh: 通过自然语言连接 SalesTouch，完成组织资料、部门、角色权限、员工邀请、下属管理范围与销售流程配置，并处理 B2B/B2C 销售执行、非销售工作、绩效、内部调研和经营汇总。
examples_en: Configure a new company's profile, units, sales and non-sales role permissions, reporting scopes, and sales process, then invite employees to activate accounts and assign their organization relationships
Summarize this week's sales, work, forms, performance, and internal research with risks, evidence gaps, and next actions
Review priority East China customers and opportunities, then create only the follow-up tasks I explicitly approve
Design a store inspection form, preview recipients, and wait for confirmation before publishing and internal distribution
Review internal research under anonymity thresholds and state findings, confidence, and unanswered interview questions
examples_zh: 为新公司完成组织资料、部门、销售与非销售角色权限和销售流程配置，再邀请员工激活帐号、分配组织关系并设置主管的下属范围
汇总本周销售、项目任务、表单、绩效和内部调研，列出风险、证据缺口和下周动作
查一下华东区重点客户和商机，先给我风险摘要，再创建已确认的跟进任务
设计一份门店巡检表，预览收件人后等我确认再发布和内部分发
读取内部调研结果，遵守匿名阈值，说明结论、置信度和还需要补访的问题
display.name: SalesTouch 经营执行
